description: Confirm a seal's integrity against the APEX PSI append-only ledger. Accepts a receipt object (from the seal tool) or a raw SHA-256 hash. Reports whether the hash is present and anchored — integrity, not the truth of the original content. Read-only: nothing is written and no record changes. Output: a JSON report stating whether the hash was found and whether it is anchored. A failure returns a tool error whose text is JSON: { success: false, error }.

hash.description: A SHA-256 hash to look up in the ledger (with or without 'sha256:' prefix)

receipt.description: A receipt object as returned by the seal tool

name: verify
title: Verify a receipt
